policy: Confirm tool availability in actual runtime; names in research != installed
USD0 default; licenses/rights per downloaded asset
Prefer existing owner factories and real model authoring over custom renderer
Know capability and version of chosen renderer: Three r163+ WebGL2 only
Choose pipeline according to actual role and constraints; do not fabricate GPU/browser proof
Search official docs first, then assets under license: query must include role, rig/UV, format and license; compare 2 when decision materially affects hero quality
No pipeline enters the studio's approved character library based on rig motion or palette swap; preserve negative visual registry.

tools.needs: Blender executable installed and version checked; cli --background example.blend --python script.py; verify output .blend/.glb and render frames
tools.when: mesh/UV/sculpt/shape keys/render must be editable or high fidelity
tools.license: GNU GPL Blender software; generated assets have separate provenance
tools.pitfall: A Python script full of cubes is still low-quality output; source-first human model quality.

tools.needs: Model editor availability / desktop or web; verify mesh/UV and actual export file; headless bridge not assumed installed
tools.when: purposeful stylized low-poly and custom atlas, not cinematic faces by default
tools.license: Check Blockbench source GPL and plugin license if bundling editor
tools.pitfall: Default cubes can give Minecraft look when brief expects crafted silhouettes.

tools.needs: Pin matching three.js and addons revision; r163+ WebGL2 only. Test phone; GLTFLoader and decoder setup
tools.when: interactive scene and public browser viewer
tools.pitfall: Newer Three no WebGL1 fallback. Code compiles ≠ GPU rendered.

tools.needs: Check CLI availability; keep original source, optimize duplicate, test skin/animation/material roundtrip; decoder config
tools.when: asset performance or validity, not for artistic character creation
tools.pitfall: Meshopt/Draco compress downloads, not guaranteed FPS gain; decode costs and fallback must be checked.

tools.needs: Same geometry+material instancing, per-instance transforms/variant textures; preserve separate semantic IDs and variations
tools.when: repeating machines, lamps, windows or identical mesh, not a human close-up identity
tools.pitfall: Does not guarantee reduced material complexity or character variety; some skinned bodies need different method.

tools.needs: Use matching KTX2Loader, transcoder files and .detectSupport(renderer); setKTX2Loader on GLTFLoader before loading
tools.when: GPU texture memory bottleneck measured; retain PNG/WebP fallback where needed
tools.license: Review linked transcoder artifact license if bundling
tools.pitfall: Don't announce KTX2 compatibility with no transcoder bytes.

tools.needs: Download exact file bytes and record source URL, license CC0, SHA and texture maps
tools.when: needs physical material light or modeled prop
tools.pitfall: A listing URL does not prove mesh was acquired or imported.

tools.needs: Existing sample GLB can be inspected only with correct asset attribution and licensing per asset; preserve CC BY 4.0 credit from prior cruce
tools.when: learning source fit and actor rig; not automatic hero choice
tools.license: Source for prior Cesium Man/Truck reported as CC BY 4.0; verify exact asset
tools.pitfall: Different license per resource; not entire Cesium repository CC BY.

tools.needs: If chosen, verify editor CLI and HTML5 export compatibility; explicit tradeoff vs Three/Blender
tools.when: game mechanics dominate over web scene, only if infrastructure exists
tools.pitfall: No automatic build/deployment assumption and not default.

tools.needs: Log network/module/asset/GPU errors separately; webglcontextcreationerror and contextlost handlers
tools.when: browser scene publication, failure in station
tools.pitfall: Do not blame WebGL for gzip import errors.

tools.needs: Check installed software, core vs studio license; save explicit frame timeline; compare with direct camera animation
tools.when: multi-shot animation needs timelines, not mandatory
tools.license: Check core Apache-2 and studio AGPL-3 if bundling/integrating
tools.pitfall: Editor licence and bundle size may matter; use only with reason.

tools.needs: Read private repo branch candidate/prometeo-3d-specialty-factories-v1-20261116 full path and owner contracts; reuse with exact IDs/SHAs
tools.when: any appropriate specialist domain; avoid duplicate implementation
tools.pitfall: 40 fixture tests are NOT GPU/visual acceptance; no forced STOP in production.

tools.needs: Actual Blender 4.2+ available, MPFB addon installed, generated mesh/material/rig inspected in app and exported; check exact asset licenses
tools.when: Source for varied human silhouettes and wardrobe before facial lookdev
tools.license: MPFB tool source GPL; generated standard assets refer to upstream license, confirm extras separately
tools.pitfall: Auto-human generator != approved closeup art; requires authoring and face/skin QA

tools.needs: VRoid Studio authoring tool and @pixiv/three-vrm loader plugin installed, exact VRM source/license and clip support verified
tools.when: Distinct stylized avatar hypothesis, subject to scene fit
tools.license: VRoid Studio model/wardrobe rights vary by imported asset
tools.pitfall: VRM needs VRMLoaderPlugin; generic GLTFLoader not enough; anime style may be wrong for realistic scenes

tools.needs: User Adobe ID and explicit access to third-party service; verify export and license/redistribution
tools.when: Custom model rigging/clip acquisition when user authorized external service
tools.license: Adobe service terms apply to exports
tools.pitfall: No automated login assumption and no borrowed proprietary game models

tools.needs: Download actual pack bytes and inspect license, skeleton and clips; retarget if needed
tools.when: Stylized rig animation hypothesis, not a substitute for face authoring
tools.license: Specific free animation pack CC0; verify bytes
tools.pitfall: Clips may not match rig and authored look may be too simplified for desired scene

actor: site:quaternius.com humanoid animated GLB CC0 character

avoidResearchLoops: Search until two materially different representations compared OR no credible options; then choose best viable and produce full scene. No extra prompts to user.
